title: Her Smile
description: “Her Smile” is an emotional story about a school dance rehearsal, a camera capturing precious moments, and a girl whose smile could brighten even the most ordinary day. Behind every recording was a memory I wanted to keep—not just of the dance, but of the happiness she brought into my world.
subtitle: Her armor...

title: Sorry
description: “Sorry” is about a memory that keeps replaying, a moment that went wrong, and the guilt of wishing you could turn back time. Behind the laughter was a feeling I couldn't explain, and behind every apology was the wish that things could have ended differently.
subtitle: I'm so careless...

title: Moonlit Verdict
description: “Moonlit Verdict” tells the story of an unexpected reunion on an important day, when seeing someone from the past made every other plan suddenly feel unimportant. Caught between an opportunity and feelings he never expressed, one silent moment became a memory he couldn't let go.
subtitle: Silent Echo...

title: Take Care
description: “Take Care” tells the story of seeing someone special just before an important interview. A simple question, a familiar smile, and a brief moment together become a memory that stays long after her jeepney disappears.
subtitle: Always...

title: Into You
description: “Into You” is a dreamy love song about finding yourself face to face with someone you've quietly admired, only to lose every word when your eyes finally meet.
subtitle: Dream came true...
